echoParts: Though your sins are like scarlet
they shall be as white as snow
though they are red like crimson
verseText: Though your sins are like scarlet, they shall be as white as snow, though they are red like crimson, they shall become like wool.
meaning: The price of sin is deep and serious: forever death! But even the filthiest sinner can be washed clean through Jesus' blood.
